# The Epoch Times

> > Independent news organization covering breaking news, U.S. politics, international affairs, business, and world events with focus on Trump administration, Iran, China, and Middle East developments.

The Epoch Times is a global news publication providing coverage of current events, political developments, economic trends, and international relations. The site emphasizes independent journalism with particular attention to U.S. domestic policy, geopolitical conflicts, and business news including housing markets and economic indicators.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Trump Administration
- Iran and Middle East Conflicts
- U.S. Military Operations
- China Relations
- Housing Policy and Mortgage Rates
- Oil Disruptions
- Kharg Island
- State Department
- Independent Journalism
- Business and Economic News
- World News Coverage
- U.S. Politics
- Veteran Support
- International Affairs
